release_notes: Scanning a product or a phone directly (the top scan box / a handheld scanner) froze the app for a second or more each time. The device lookup was reading **every** device and re-checking all their barcodes and IMEIs one by one in memory; it now finds the match with a single fast lookup. The whole scan (and acting on a scanned phone — sold / reserved / back to stock) now also runs in the background, so scanning stays instant.
